description: RadiAnt DICOM Viewer is a Windows application developed by Medixant for viewing and manipulating DICOM medical-imaging studies.
title: RadiAnt DICOM Viewer

description: Radiology Assistant is a free, case-based radiology education platform developed by radiologist Robin Smithuis and operated as a non-profit organization for the Radiological Society of the Netherlands.
title: Radiology Assistant

description: Raging Skies is a digital game-based assessment developed by Ying Cui and colleagues that measures Grade 5 students' weather knowledge through storm-chasing tasks, adaptive difficulty, and in-game and summary feedback.
title: Raging Skies

description: A justice-centered framework proposed by Shahin Hossain et al.
title: RAIL-Ed framework

description: Rain Classroom is an e-learning platform co-developed by Tsinghua University and XuetangX that integrates PowerPoint and WeChat for synchronous participation, quizzes, feedback, and learning analytics.
title: Rain Classroom

description: A pronunciation diagnostic assessment that uses the Rainbow passage, automatic speech-to-text transcription, and segmental error-rate scoring to identify learners' pronunciation errors.
title: Rainbow passage with ASR transcription and segmental error rate (SER)

description: A checklist created by Allison for standardising disclosure and review of AI-enabled educational research manuscripts across ten thematic domains.
title: RAISE 2025 Checklist (v1.0) with editable supplementary version

description: A supplementary fillable framework proposed by Allison (2026) for authors to identify, assess, and report ethical risks and mitigation strategies in educational AI studies.
title: RAISE 2025 Ethics and Risk Matrix

description: A supplementary RAISE guidance document providing side-by-side bad and good reporting examples and explanations to help authors produce clear, transparent, aligned, and reproducible AI-focused educational research reports.
title: RAISE 2025 Reporting Examples and Explanation document

description: RAISE (Reading Apprenticeship Improving Student Engagement) is a year-long professional-development programme that trains secondary teachers in Reading Apprenticeship literacy, metacognitive inquiry, and collaborative-learning practices through face-to-face sessions and teacher-leader on-site suppor
title: RAISE professional development model

description: RAMPUP is a named mathematics-learning programme developed and run by its project team, using contextualized activity structures to support students’ equivalence reasoning.
title: RAMPUP

description: A three-week summer bridge mathematics programme developed through WestEd’s National Research and Development Center to Improve Education for Secondary English Learners, serving rising ninth-grade students through modules on patterns, networks, and equivalence.
title: RAMPUP (Reimagining and Amplifying Mathematics Participation, Understanding, and Practices)

description: A literature-derived and professionally Q-sorted framework of 72 family-centred-care competencies for guiding education and evaluating hospital nurses, developed by Hengeveld et al.
title: Ranked Q-set of 72 nursing competencies for family-centred care in hospitals

description: Ranking Facts is an open-source web-based tool developed by Lewis Armanda and Julia Stoyanovich that generates user-friendly summaries of algorithmic ranking properties for lay audiences and data-science learners.
title: Ranking Facts

description: A simulation-based procedural-training framework used by clinical educators that structures repeated skill cycles with immediate targeted feedback and error correction until performance improves.
title: Rapid-cycle deliberate practice (RCDP)

description: Rapid Phonics is Pearson's structured synthetic-phonics intervention, developed from Sound Discovery by Marlynne Grant, for teaching grapheme–phoneme correspondences, blending, decoding, spelling, and reading fluency to struggling or beginner readers.
title: Rapid Phonics synthetic phonics catch-up programme

description: RULA is a validated observational assessment scale developed by McAtamney and Corlett for scoring upper-limb posture and work-related musculoskeletal ergonomic risk, including in seated professional tasks.
title: Rapid Upper Limb Assessment (RULA)

description: A Delphi-developed observational assessment instrument for trained reviewers to score technical steps, errors, and critical errors in full-case videos of specified anterior transperitoneal nerve-sparing robot-assisted radical prostatectomy procedures.
title: RARP procedure performance metrics: 12 phases, 81 steps, 145 errors and 32 critical errors

description: A structured curriculum-based intervention derived from rational emotive behavior therapy that teaches learners to replace irrational beliefs with rational ones and develop more self-enhancing ways of thinking, feeling, and acting.
title: Rational emotive behavior education (REBE)

description: A school-counselor consultation model developed by Warren et al.
title: Rational emotive-social behavior consultation (RE-SBC)

description: A 50-item, five-point Likert self-report creativity scale developed by Raudsepp and adapted into Turkish by Çoban to measure individuals’ creative behaviors, values, interests, motivations, and personal attributes.
title: Raudsepp “How Creative Are You?” creativity scale (Turkish adaptation)

description: An online platform developed by experts in spatial ability and geometry that provides organized spatial-problem task groups for teacher-assigned practice and performance measurement.
title: RaumIntelligenzFörderung (RIF) platform for spatial ability development and measurement

description: A scripted academic-vocabulary curriculum developed by McKeown et al.
title: RAVE intervention

description: A Ray Medical robotic oral-surgery and implant-navigation platform combining robotic manipulation, optical tracking, imaging, and navigation software for clinical training and remote instruction.
title: Ray Medical RD-100 oral surgery robot and implant navigation platform
